tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: L0: page background, about 60% of the screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: L1: sidebar, cards, list panels, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows, ghost buttons, menu items; segmented track.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill; neutral tiles.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All text on canvas and surface (16:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta and helper text: domains, dates, counts, hints. 4.5:1 on canvas, surface, hover and selected.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline: the 1px edge of L1 surfaces and row dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edge of L2 and L3 surfaces, secondary buttons, hovered cards.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and dashed chips (3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Graphite accent: the one main action per view, switches on, active view, links in text. At most 10% of the screen.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the current navigation item, pressed chips.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text on accent-bg.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every control; the only blue in the interface.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: The AI spark and the edge of AI suggestions. Never a fill for text blocks.

tokens.name: ai-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the large AI tile only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, always with words.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Duplicate link and limits, always with words.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations, always with words.

tokens.name: star
